theater: 河南禹州三峰山與鈞州

battle.name: 三峰山之戰
battle.theater: 河南禹州三峰山與鈞州
battle.brief: 一二三二年正月，蒙古睿宗拖雷與大汗窩闊台大軍在河南禹州三峰山截住北援的金國十五萬大軍。暴雪三日，金軍僵凍糧絕，蒙古軍輪番攻殺，縱其奔鈞州再夾擊，金軍遂潰，完顏合達戰死、移剌蒲阿被擒不降。弩是金軍攻守兩端的骨幹火力，此役之後金軍甲兵散盡，兩年後蔡州陷落。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是蒙古帝國與金國。金國一方是宣宗以來由樞密院、軍令簽院調度的漢地防軍，北援主力由完顏合達統轄，下轄完顏陳和尚、武仙等部，兵種分為騎兵二萬與步兵十三萬，其中「河北軍」多為簽軍與鄉兵改編，裝備與訓練參差，士氣低落。金廷自潼關以西盡失之後，把全部指望押在援軍回師解汴京之圍上。金國南面還有南宋：蒙古拖雷一軍要求借道攻金，南宋拒絕，兩家在唐、鄧之間短兵相接，蒙古於是取道唐州、鄧州，繞開正面。蒙古一方是草原帝國立國以來最大規模的一次野戰兵團，由睿宗拖雷所領的東路大軍與大汗窩闊台親率的中路大軍會合成軍，以騎兵為主，編制仍以十進制為骨幹，並徵用漢地降附的步卒、工匠與攻城技術，隨軍攜帶攻城器材與大量備用馬匹。兩軍指揮體系的差異，最終決定了戰局：金國以皇帝詔令與樞密院調度，每一步都要等汴京的往返文書；蒙古則以大汗與諸王分軍合擊、臨機決斷，拖雷得以自行挑選截擊的地點與時機。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Mongol Empire and the Jin dynasty. The Jin fielded a Han Chinese field army administered by the Privy Council and the Military Command Office of the late Jin court. The relief host was under the command of Wanyan Heda, with Wanyan Chenheshang, Wuxian and others beneath him, and was composed of 20,000 cavalry and 130,000 infantry; many of the units of the so-called Hebei army were hastily enrolled militia and locally levied men whose equipment and drill were uneven and whose morale had already collapsed. With everything west of Tong Pass lost, the Jin court pinned all its hopes on the relief host marching back to lift the siege of the capital. To the south lay the Southern Song: Tolui's column demanded passage through Song territory to attack the Jin, the Song refused, the two sides fought at Tang and Deng, and the Mongols simply took the road through Tangzhou and Dengzhou instead. On the Mongol side stood the largest field army the steppe empire had ever mustered, formed when the eastern column of Tolui, brother and heir of Ögedei, joined with the central host led by the Great Khan Ögedei himself. Cavalry formed its backbone, the organisation still rested on the decimal system, and Han Chinese auxiliaries, craftsmen, siege engineers and a great many remounts marched with it. The difference between the two command systems decided the outcome. The Jin could move only on imperial orders relayed from Bianjing, every step waiting on documents travelling back and forth, while the Mongols split into columns that struck in concert and moved on their own initiative. Tolui was therefore free to choose the ground and the hour at which to meet the Jin host.
people: 拖雷是這一役真正的主腦。他是窩闊台的胞弟，蒙古「四駿」中的長兄，1229年監國，1231年奉命統兵東進。他不急於直趨汴京，而是在唐州、鄧州一線游弋，等到金國援軍離開堅城、在雪野行軍中疲弊，才以三千騎跟蹤、以大軍邀擊，選了最狠的一刀。金國主帥完顏合達是完顏宗室老將，久與蒙古人交手，先在貝州擊敗過史天澤，時人評他知兵事，是金國末期最能打的將領之一；但他主張穩守、遲疑未戰，前段反而讓移剌蒲阿的主張主導。移剌蒲阿是西面統帥，1230年他軟禁蒙古使節，又揚言金軍不怕蒙古，兩國從此再無轉圜；1231年馳援鳳翔時他徘徊不前，害得潼關以西盡失。此役他主持的禹山之戰明明蒙古軍已少卻，他仍力主不追，隨後又隱瞞敗訊、虛報大捷，害得河南郡縣毫無戒備。金國大將完顏陳和尚作戰勇猛，鈞州城破後不願無名死於亂軍，親到敵營拒降被殺。另一位被裹挾的將領是武仙，他僥倖逃出，收羅十萬潰兵屯於鄧州留山、威遠寨，重立旗鼓，卻在1233年被宋將孟珙擊潰，1234年蔡州陷落時金祚終結。蒙古軍中另有被記載的康里巫師，傳說他以法術引來暴雪為蒙古軍助勢，雖近於神話，卻反映雙方都把氣候視為戰場上不可控的力量。
peopleEn: Tolui was the real author of this battle. He was Ögedei's own brother, the eldest of the four sons of Genghis Khan, regent from 1229, and commander of the eastern army in 1231. He did not hurry against Bianjing; he stayed in the neighbourhood of Tangzhou and Dengzhou, waited until the Jin relief army had left its fortified positions and was exhausted on the march through the snow, and only then sent three thousand riders to shadow it while bringing up the main body to cut it off, taking the hardest of blows. The Jin commander Wanyan Heda was an old warrior of the imperial clan who had fought the Mongols for years and had defeated Shiti Tianze at Beizhou; contemporaries judged him a man who understood the art of war, and one of the last competent commanders the Jin had. He favoured patience and was slow to commit, and in the opening phase it was the plan of Yelü Pua that shaped events instead. Yelü Pua commanded the western army; in 1230 he had detained Mongol envoys and then boasted that the Jin had horses ready to fight, after which there was no turning back for either side; in 1231 his hesitation in coming to the relief of Fengxiang cost the Jin everything west of Tong Pass. At the fight on Yushan, when the Mongol horse had already given ground, he still pressed the decision not to pursue, and afterwards he concealed the defeat and reported a great victory, leaving the districts of Henan utterly unprepared. Wanyan Chenheshang fought boldly and, when Jinzhou fell, refused to die nameless in the rout, going to the Mongol camp to refuse surrender and was killed there. Another general caught up in the disaster was Wuxian, who escaped and gathered a hundred thousand routed men at Liushan and Weiyuan stockade near Dengzhou, raising fresh banners and standards, only to be beaten in 1233 by the Song general Meng Gong, with the Jin state ending at Caizhou in 1234. The Mongol host also included a Kangli shaman whom the records credit with summoning the blizzard by sorcery to fight for the Mongols; the tale borders on legend, but it shows that both sides treated the weather as an uncontrollable force on the battlefield.
kits: 本卡的十字弩，代表的是十二世紀以後在歐亞同步成熟的弩技術：弩機把拉弦的力矩存起來，射手只須扣機放矢，強度遠高於弓，射速卻遠低於弓。金國與蒙古的配備並不相同。金軍的弩分兩類：攜帶的「強弩」需借助蹶張器上弦，遠射可及百步以上，用於守城、伏擊與壓制騎兵；「床子弩」則架在車或小型台架上，作為陣地與城頭的固定火力。蒙古騎軍的骨架是複合反曲弓，射速快、騎射便利，本不在弩的使用傳統之內，但蒙古軍在攻金、西夏與西亞的戰事中大量繳獲並改編漢地弩手，攻城大軍中亦有「弩砲」一類的重型投射器，與得自波斯工匠的攻城砲同列。1232年蒙古兵繞道漢水、以唐州為基地直趨汴京，隨行的攻城器材正包括這類重型投射機與火藥箭。弩在三峰山本身的價值有限：雪深沒脛、槍槊結凍如椽，拉得開弦的手指與凍僵的關節才是瓶頸，混戰一旦展開，弩手的射速趕不上騎兵。真正被掠奪的是裝備：金軍崩潰時散落的甲兵無算，武仙在留山、威遠寨重整器仗，1233年荊襄戰線又被宋將孟珙大量繳去，記作「獲甲兵無算」。歐洲同期在做同樣的事：英格蘭與威爾士的十字弩在十二世紀末已成為守城與野戰的常備，弩手以鉛矢或鐵矢射穿甲面——這正是弩在十三世紀被譽為「城牆上比長弓可靠、野戰裡比長弓脆弱」的原因。
kitsEn: The crossbow on this card represents a technology that matured across Eurasia after the twelfth century: the lock stores the torque of the drawn string, so the archer need only press the trigger and loose the bolt, and the result is far more powerful than a bow and far slower to reload. The two sides equipped themselves differently. The Jin crossbows came in two kinds: the portable strong crossbow, cocked with a crane or windlass and capable of shooting a hundred paces or more, used to defend walls, to lie in ambush and to pin down cavalry; and the bed-narrow crossbow, mounted on a cart or a light frame, which served as fixed firepower on the field and on the wall. The backbone of the Mongol horse was the composite reflex bow, fast to shoot and convenient from the saddle, and crossbows were not part of the Mongol tradition; but the Mongols captured large numbers of Han crossbowmen and incorporated them in their campaigns against the Jin, the Western Xia and in Central Asia, and their siege trains included heavy crossbow artillery of the type called crossbow trebuchets, listed alongside the siege engines taken from Persian craftsmen. In 1232 the Mongol army turned along the Han River, used Tangzhou as its base and drove straight for Bianjing, and the siege equipment that marched with it included such heavy projectors and fire arrows. The value of the crossbow at Mount Three Peaks itself was limited: with snow up to the shin and spears frozen solid like rafters, the binding constraint was the fingers of the archers and the stiffened joints of the crossbowmen, and once the melee began the rate of the crossbow could not keep pace with horsemen. What was really plundered was equipment: the Jin host lost uncounted armour and weapons in the rout, Wuxian re-equipped the survivors at Liushan and Weiyuan stockade, and in 1233 the Jingxiang front saw Meng Gong of Song capture an immense haul again, recorded as capturing armour and weapons beyond number. Europe was doing the same thing at the time: the crossbow had become standard in English and Welsh service by the end of the twelfth century, in the hands of both garrison and field troops, shooting lead or iron bolts through armour — which is exactly why the crossbow was praised in the thirteenth century as more reliable than the longbow on a wall and more fragile than the longbow in the open field.
tactics: 蒙古的戰法可以拆成三步。第一步是擾：1231年十二月禹山之戰，蒙古軍不與金軍全力交鋒，把隊形散開如雁翅，繞過山麓從騎兵側後分三隊殺入，兩度交鋒便退；其後四天，蒙古兵在漢水對岸光化軍一帶的棗林裏晝夜不停、不下馬、不生火，林外不聞一聲，金軍以為他們已經撤走。第二步是疲：往鈞州方向的三峰山，拖雷只留三千騎跟蹤金軍，每次挑釁都選在金軍造飯與宿營的時候，讓十五萬人始終得不到休息，也沒有補給。第三步是殲：金軍走到鈞州三峰山時，拖雷的三萬兵馬與窩闊台的大軍同時趕到合圍；蒙古軍並不急攻，而是四面圍住，輪番休息進攻，帳外熾薪燔牛羊肉取暖，專等金軍在雪裡僵凍、斷糧三日。待金軍撐不住，蒙古軍故意讓開通往鈞州的路，等潰軍爭相奔逃，再以生力軍夾擊腰斬，戰場上人喊馬嘶，聲如崩山。金軍的戰術本不弱：列步兵於山前、騎兵於山後是金軍的標準部署，合達也看得出蒙古軍人數不足三萬而輜重居其一，久持必然疲竭，主張等對方自己退下再一擊；只是分兵追擊的時機與退路被雪與地形吃光，隊形一散便再無回旋。鈞州城下，金軍把殘部收進城垣，依托守具死守，終究城破。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method can be broken into three steps. The first was harassment: at the fight on Yushan in December 1231 the Mongols did not commit their full strength against the Jin, but drew their formation out like the spread of geese, swung round the foot of the hill to fall on the flank and rear of the Jin cavalry in three columns, and broke off after two exchanges. For the four days that followed the Mongols lay in a jujube grove on the far bank of the Han River near Guanghua, never dismounting, never lighting fires, never making a sound outside the trees, so that the Jin concluded they had withdrawn. The second step was exhaustion: on the road to Jinzhou the Mongols shadowed the Jin host with only three thousand riders, choosing to provoke them every time the enemy was cooking or bedding down, so that a hundred and fifty thousand men never rested and never received supplies. The third step was annihilation: when the Jin host reached Mount Three Peaks near Jinzhou, Tolui's thirty thousand men and Ögedei's main body arrived at the same moment to close the ring. The Mongols did not press at once. They surrounded the host on all sides, attacked in turn and rested in turn, burned fuel and roasted beef and mutton outside the tents for warmth, and waited for the Jin to freeze in the snow and to go three days without food. When the Jin could hold out no longer, the Mongols deliberately opened the road to Jinzhou; the broken host rushed for it, and the fresh troops fell on its flank and cut it in half, the noise of the rout like a collapsing mountain. The Jin tactics were not bad in themselves: infantry in front and cavalry behind was their standard deployment, and Heda could see that the Mongols numbered fewer than thirty thousand with a third of that in baggage and could not stand a long contest, so he argued for letting the enemy tire and withdraw before striking. But the moment for a pursuit and the road home were eaten away by snow and by the ground, and once the formation came apart there was no recovery. At Jinzhou the Jin drew the remnants inside the wall and fought behind its defences, and the city fell in the end.
data: 可核對的數字有幾組。金軍北援兵力十五萬，其中騎兵二萬、步兵十三萬，見於《金史·完顏合達傳》；蒙古拖雷所部「不足四萬」，其中跟蹤金軍的分遣隊三千人，截擊時投入的三萬兵馬，窩闊台本部兵數史無明文。汴京城內只剩四萬軍士與二萬壯丁可用，這正是金廷非逼援軍回師不可的原因。時間線是：1231年八月拖雷破大散關、鳳州，十月十一月間入饒鳳關，十二月禹山交鋒，1232年正月三峰山合圍與鈞州城破，二月蒙古軍在洛陽立砲攻城。距離上，金軍自鄧州到鈞州約百里，接近一百公里，十五萬人加上三日雪、泥濘沒脛的田地，行軍縱隊拉得極長。氣候與地形的記錄相當具體：雪已三日，白霧蔽空，人不相覿，戰地多麻田，耕四五過，人馬所踐泥濘沒脛，槍槊結凍如椽，軍士有不食至三日者。損失方面，金軍陣亡被記為數萬人，鈞州城破後合達戰死、陳和尚拒降被殺、移剌蒲阿被擒不降；十萬潰兵被武仙收羅於留山、威遠寨，翌年被孟珙擊敗，投降七萬人，被宋軍獲甲兵無算。
dataEn: Several sets of figures can be checked. The Jin relief force numbered 150,000, of whom 20,000 were cavalry and 130,000 infantry, as recorded in the History of Jin's biography of Wanyan Heda; Tolui's column was given as fewer than 40,000, of which 3,000 formed the detachment that shadowed the Jin and 30,000 took part in the interception, while no source gives the size of Ögedei's own host. Inside Bianjing only 40,000 soldiers and 20,000 able-bodied men remained, and that is why the court had to force the relief army back. The chronology runs: August 1231, Tolui breaks through Dasan Pass and Fengzhou; October and November, he enters Raofeng Pass; December, the clash on Yushan; the first month of 1232, the encirclement at Mount Three Peaks and the fall of Jinzhou; the second month, the Mongols erect their artillery before Luoyang. In distance, the march from Dengzhou to Jinzhou is about one hundred li, close to a hundred kilometres, and a hundred and fifty thousand men stretched into column, together with three days of snow and fields of hemp where the mud reached the shin, made the column enormously long. The record of weather and ground is unusually exact: the snow had already fallen for three days, white fog shut out the sky, men could not see one another, the battlefield was full of hemp fields ploughed four or five times, the mud sank to the shin beneath the hooves of men and horses, spears and javelins froze as solid as rafters, and some soldiers went three days without food. On losses, the Jin dead are recorded as tens of thousands; after Jinzhou fell, Heda was killed in action, Chenheshang was killed after refusing to surrender, and Yelü Pua was taken and refused to submit. The hundred thousand routed men were gathered by Wuxian at Liushan and Weiyuan stockade; the following year they were beaten by Meng Gong, surrendered in the number of 70,000, and the Song took from them armour and weapons beyond number.
cause: 原因有遠有近。遠因是成吉思汗臨終前留下的遺計：金精兵在潼關，南據連山，北限黃河，難以遽破，若假道於宋，宋金世仇必許，則可下兵唐、鄧，直搗大梁，金急必徵兵潼關，援兵千里赴援，人馬疲弊，雖至弗能戰，破之必矣。拖雷在1231年強行執行這套「借道」計畫：南宋拒絕，他就在八月由大散關攻破鳳州、屠洋州，十一月攻入饒鳳關；其後由金州順漢水東出，取唐州、鄧州。直接導火線在1230年：蒙古遣使到金軍營議和，金將移剌蒲阿軟禁使節，後來揚言「我已準備軍馬，可戰鬥來」，放還使節，窩闊台聞之大怒，決意大舉。1232年正月，蒙古兵繞道漢水從唐州攻打汴京，京師告急，金哀宗只能命完顏合達、移剌蒲阿率十五萬人北援，於是兩軍在回援路上必然相遇。更深一層的結構性原因是，金國在潼關、陝西喪失之後，財政、兵源與裝備都靠臨時括取，十五萬大軍的紙面數字遠高於可持續作戰的實力；而蒙古是以騎兵為主、可不斷以小股襲擾消耗對手的遠征型軍隊，一支不需佔領城池、只需拖垮對手的軍隊。
causeEn: The causes are both distant and immediate. The distant one is the plan Genghis Khan left on his deathbed: the Jin's best troops sat behind Tong Pass, holding the mountain chain to the south and the Yellow River to the north, and could not be broken in a hurry; but if the Mongols borrowed the road through Song, and Song and Jin were old enemies, the Song would surely agree, and the army could then move down through Tang and Deng and strike straight at Daliang. Jin, in alarm, would have to call up troops from Tong Pass, who would cover a thousand li, arrive exhausted, and be unable to fight, and would therefore be certain to be beaten. Tolui forced this borrowing-of-the-road plan through in 1231: the Southern Song refused, so in August he broke Dasan Pass and Fengzhou and sacked Yangzhou, and in November he entered Raofeng Pass; afterwards he came down the Han River from Jinzhou and took Tangzhou and Dengzhou. The immediate spark came in 1230: the Mongols sent envoys to the Jin camp to negotiate, and the Jin general Yelü Pua detained them and then declared that he already had his warhorses ready and they could come and fight, and released them; Ögedei, furious, decided on a great campaign. In the first month of 1232 the Mongols turned along the Han River and struck at Bianjing from Tangzhou, and with the capital in danger Jin Emperor Aizong could only order Wanyan Heda and Yelü Pua to bring 150,000 men north, so the two armies were bound to meet on that march. Deeper still, having lost Tong Pass and the lands beyond, the Jin's revenue, manpower and equipment all depended on hasty levies, and the paper strength of 150,000 was far beyond what it could sustain in battle; the Mongols, by contrast, were an expeditionary army of horsemen that could wear an enemy down with repeated small attacks without needing to occupy cities, only to break them.
impact: 三峰山一役是金國由衰亡走向覆滅的轉折點。兵力的損失雖非全軍盡沒——十萬潰兵後來還能被武仙收編、屯於留山——但真正被摧毀的是金國最後一批能打的將領與他們手中的裝備：完顏合達、完顏陳和尚、楊沃衍、樊澤、高英、張惠等相繼陣亡或被俘，金廷從此兵不復振，史家直接斷言金國滅亡已不可逆。裝備上的損失更難補：蒙軍在潰退中繳獲的甲兵無算，荊襄戰線1233年孟珙再繳武仙部甲兵無算，金國連一支像樣的弩兵與騎兵都難以重建。戰局上，開封解圍希望破滅後，1232年二月蒙古軍渡河清徑、在洛陽立砲攻城，河北、河南、山西州縣相繼淪陷，1233年蒙古在河南取得決定性優勢，1234年正月宋蒙聯軍攻陷蔡州，金哀宗自盡，金朝滅亡，北方土地盡入蒙古。這一役同時拉開了蒙古第二次西征的序幕：1232年拔都、速不台率軍向歐洲進發，1237年別兒哥則在東歐擊敗羅馬教廷與匈牙利、俄羅斯等國的聯軍。戰略層面上，此役確立了蒙古「不急攻城、專截援軍」的戰役樣板，對後來蒙古在歐洲與中亞的用兵影響深遠。
impactEn: Mount Three Peaks was the hinge on which the Jin turned from decline to destruction. The army was not wiped out — a hundred thousand routed men could still be gathered by Wuxian and encamped at Liushan — but what was destroyed was the last body of competent Jin commanders and the equipment they carried: Wanyan Heda, Wanyan Chenheshang, Yang Woyan, Fan Ze, Gao Ying and Zhang Hui were killed or captured one after another, the court could never rally its troops again, and historians called the destruction of the Jin then a certainty. The loss of equipment was still harder to make good: the Mongols took uncounted armour and weapons from the rout, and in 1233 Meng Gong of Song took uncounted armour and weapons again from Wuxian's army on the Jingxiang front, so that the Jin could not rebuild so much as a proper corps of crossbowmen and horsemen. Strategically, once the hope of relieving Bianjing was gone, in the second month of 1232 the Mongols crossed the river at Heqing and set up their artillery before Luoyang, and the prefectures of Hebei, Henan and Shanxi fell one after another; in 1233 the Mongols gained the decisive advantage in Henan, and in the first month of 1234 the Song-Mongol allied armies stormed Caizhou, where Emperor Aizong killed himself and the Jin dynasty ended, its lands passing to the Mongols. The same battle opened the Mongols' second western campaign: in 1232 Batu and Subutai marched into Europe, and in 1237 Subutai's son Jebe broke the coalition of the Roman curia, Hungary and Rus on the eastern European plain. At the level of method, this battle set the Mongol pattern of not hurrying to besiege cities but cutting off relief armies, and it deeply influenced Mongol campaigning in Europe and Central Asia afterwards.
result: 結局是金軍全軍覆沒式的崩潰。三峰山合圍中，金軍在雪中僵凍三日、斷糧三日，蒙古四面輪番攻殺，輪到休息時帳外熾薪烤牛羊肉，待金軍困憊，蒙古主動讓開通往鈞州之路；金軍爭先奔逃，突圍至半途被生力軍攔腰截斷，兵勢聲如崩山。完顏合達與完顏陳和尚退入鈞州城，旋即被蒙軍破城，合達戰死，陳和尚親至敵營拒降被殺；移剌蒲阿向汴京逃奔被擒，不降而死。隨後，潰兵散入昌武軍、洛陽一帶，洛陽城中只得到三峰山潰卒三四千人與百餘忠孝軍守城，二月蒙古軍便在洛陽立砲攻城。金國最後的指望在南方：1233年南宋孟珙掃平留山、威遠寨，擊敗武仙並受其眾七萬人，1234年正月蔡州城破，金朝終結。此役之後，蒙古獲得了打通中原與西域的穩定通道：金國的喪失，換來蒙古在華北的統治，並讓宋蒙聯軍有了可以合作攻滅的最後一個目標。
resultEn: The outcome was a collapse of the Jin army to the point of destruction. In the encirclement at Mount Three Peaks the Jin froze for three days and went three days without food; the Mongols attacked in turn on all four sides and, when they rested, burned fuel and roasted beef and mutton outside the tents, and when the Jin could hold out no longer the Mongols deliberately opened the road to Jinzhou. The broken host rushed forward, was cut in half by fresh troops half way out of the breach, and the noise of the rout was like a collapsing mountain. Wanyan Heda and Wanyan Chenheshang withdrew into the city of Jinzhou, which was then stormed: Heda was killed in the fighting and Chenheshang went to the enemy camp, refused to surrender and was killed there; Yelü Pua fled toward Bianjing, was taken, and refused to submit. The survivors scattered to Changwu Army and Luoyang; Luoyang could muster only three or four thousand men from the routed troops of Mount Three Peaks together with a hundred or so of the Loyal and Filial Army, and in the second month the Mongols set their artillery before the city. Jin's last hope lay to the south: in 1233 the Song general Meng Gong swept Liushan and Weiyuan stockade, defeated Wuxian and took the surrender of 70,000 of his men; in the first month of 1234 Caizhou fell and the Jin dynasty ended. In the wake of the battle the Mongols gained a secure corridor joining the Central Plain with the western regions: the loss of the Jin brought Mongol rule over North China, and gave the Song-Mongol alliance a last common target to destroy.
